name: Wife Submit To Your Husband
overview: Scripture teaches that wives are called to submit to their own husbands as to the Lord, reflecting a divine order established since Genesis where the husband is given a leadership role. This submission is not a matter of inferiority but part of a mutual relationship grounded in reverence and love, as husbands are commanded to love their wives sacrificially, just as Christ loved the church. The call to submit is framed within the context of submitting to one another in the fear of God, emphasizing a Christ-centered partnership marked by respect and care.
